rules: One field has one owner. Canvas model picks stay in the shared media node model-pick slots.
settings.modelPick.set is the global default only. It is not a node, role, actor, or asset pick.
Standalone actor refs omit storyId and an empty nodes.story_id. Preference rows do not include story_id.
Unavailable and read-only fields publish null writeToolId and null actionType.
Role, actor, and visual-asset preferences stay unavailable until a published action exists.
Search is not filtered by mainTab. Same display names stay distinct through refKey and ancestorPath.
